_note: Standing show focus set by DJ Stace on Oct. 8, 2026. kzsu-weekly-recon and kzsu-weekly-playlist should read this file and apply it. Artists below come from config/taste_profile.json (shows, last_spin).
target_share_of_playlist: 15 to 20 percent (about 10 to 14 tracks of a 70-track weekly list; 6 to 8 in the 2-hour show)
rules: Build from her taste profile first: lapsed favorites, then new releases and anniversaries from the same scene.
Mix eras in each set: one classic (1976-1984) next to one current band so it sounds like her show, not an oldies block.
Texas punk gets a recurring slot (Scratch Acid, Butthole Surfers, Big Boys, The Dicks, The Jesus Lizard).
FCC screen every track. Scratch Acid, Butthole Surfers and Dead Kennedys are likely to need her radio edits or a different song.
Prefer 2:00-and-under songs from the 'Songs 2:00 and less' playlist for punk fill.
Log anything she deletes or adds as usual (60-day cool-off for deletes).
